Sr Business Analyst - AI Transformation ROLE OVERVIEW
We are looking for a Sr Business Analyst who can design, develop, and deploy production-grade Gen AI solutions for real business problems. This role combines hands-on engineering, experimentation, and deployment of LLM-powered applications across healthcare, operations, and internal workflows. The ideal candidate can move from prototype to production while working closely with business teams and external AI partners.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
AI Solution Development
Build and deploy Gen AI applications across healthcare, supply chain, retail, and enterprise workflows.
Design scalable backend systems and APIs for AI-driven applications.
LLM Engineering
Build applications using LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent.
Implement prompt engineering, evaluation pipelines, and model optimization.
Work on RAG pipelines, vector search, document retrieval, and enterprise knowledge systems.
AI Deployment Operations
Productionize AI solutions with reliability, monitoring, and observability.
Optimize latency, token usage, and inference costs.
Build evaluation systems for quality benchmarking across models and vendors.
Maintain deployment pipelines and support enterprise scaling.
Partner Product Collaboration
Collaborate with internal business teams to understand use cases.
Work with external AI vendors and implementation partners.
Evaluate build vs buy decisions and support AI architecture choices.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Experience
2-4 yrs AI/ML engineering
Min. 1 yr hands-on Gen AI / LLM dev
Shipped AI apps to production
Technical Skills
Python (strong)
Pandas
NumPy
Scikit-learn
OpenAI, Claude, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI
Vector DBs, embeddings, RAG
API dev MLOps
Preferred
Speech / audio AI
AI evaluation frameworks
AI observability governance
Healthcare or e-commerce domain
TOOLS TECHNOLOGIES
Python
SQL
LangChain
LlamaIndex
OpenAI / Anthropic
AWS Bedrock
Databricks
Prompt Engineering
Agentic AI
Vector Databases
AI Monitoring
Observability
